object.attr: derived: CF-S6, E13, and MELLON-CHECK-SRS's D-C2. A manifest deleted or renamed by hand or in a merge would otherwise drop the document and its outgoing links silently; its object or links files show it was a document. Testing for files named after the folder, not for any objects folder, keeps code folders out.
object.description: If a folder directly under the repository root holds no file <folder name>.xml but holds a file objects/<folder name>-<n>.xml or links/<folder name>-<n>.xml, Mellon shall report a load error for the folder.
